facts.fact: The marketplace opened at launch with plugins from six partners: MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, and Superpowers.
facts.quote: The marketplace opens with plugins from partners across the stack:

facts.fact: Users can browse the catalog in Grok Build by typing /marketplace and install a plugin by pressing i.
facts.quote: Inside Grok Build, type `/marketplace` to browse the catalog and press `i` to install a plugin.

facts.fact: A plugin can be installed from the terminal with the command grok plugin install <name> --trust.
Every remote plugin in the catalog is pinned to a specific commit SHA, and Grok Build verifies that pin at install time.
facts.quote: Every remote plugin in the catalog is pinned to a specific commit SHA, and Grok Build verifies the pin at install time.

facts.fact: Plugins can be browsed, installed, and updated within the terminal without leaving it, since the marketplace is built into Grok Build.
facts.quote: so you can browse, install, and update plugins without leaving your terminal.

facts.fact: The marketplace is an open catalog, and developers submit their own plugins by pull request to the xai-org/plugin-marketplace GitHub repository.
